$description: Corporate Blue preset — professional, trust-forward palette with a deep blue primary and cool neutral greys. Suitable for B2B dashboards, enterprise tools, and financial interfaces. It sets all 69 colour slots and all 27 chart slots from one brand recipe (light roles and charts) over brand A's light theme; every other slot starts from brand A. Load it as a starting point with brand.intake (action "template", from { "preset": "corporate-blue" }), then validate and create the brand. Brand-relative: no color.brand.<id> wrapper, so it serves any brand.
